settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Manage sign-in, integrations, and application settings.
settings.authentication_body: Save a draft and test sign-in with your verified admin email before activating credentials. Current sign-in stays available during testing.
settings.first_admin_body: Configure a provider and sign in with the verified email below. This account becomes the first administrator.
settings.secret_saved: A secret is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
settings.draft_saved: Draft saved. Test sign-in before activation.
settings.saved_restart: Settings saved. Restart the API to apply the listening address.
settings.tested: Sign-in verified. You can activate this draft.
settings.request_failed: Could not save or load settings. Check the values and your connection, then try again.
settings.conflict: Settings changed or this action is not ready. Reload settings and test the draft before activation. Keep at least one sign-in provider enabled.
settings.authorization_failed: Sign-in could not be verified. Use the configured administrator email and test the current draft again.
settings.access_denied: Only administrators can manage application settings.
settings.deployment_body: Settings are stored in the database. The listening address requires an API restart and matching proxy configuration. Apply webhook secret changes to alert senders too.
settings.callback_confirmation: Register these callback URLs with your providers before saving. Pending authorizations will expire and you will be redirected to the new URL.
settings.health_failed: API or database is unavailable. Check the service logs.
settings.check_integrations: Review integration status and test connections
settings.installed: Initial configuration saved. You are signed in as administrator.
settings.installation_body: Enter the installation token from deployment configuration. This access closes permanently after the first administrator signs in.
settings.installation_failed: Could not open installation access. Check the token or use the browser with the active installation session.
settings.installation_closed: Initial configuration is unavailable. Sign in to manage settings.
